  • Villain/environment are irrelevant

  • AA needs to deal a lot of damage, either by his own doing or forced by other cards. (Does it have to be against non-heroes? Certain amount vs. environment? Certain amount vs. villains? Minimum amount of damage in one turn?)

Villain/environment are irrelevant-

True.

QuirkyDM:

AA needs to deal a lot of damage, either by his own doing or forced by other cards.

(Does it have to be against non-heroes? Certain amount vs. environment? Certain amount vs. villains?

Minimum amount of damage in one turn?)

Seems unlikely.  rj917 maxed out at 5 damage in one turn.  I did as little as zero damage in one round.

QuirkyDM:
  • It doesn't matter if AA is incapacitated or not. (What about the other heroes?)

Untested.

QuirkyDM:
  • AA can't use songs on other heroes. Yes or no?

That's the running theory.  No successes have involved using any song on any other hero, and there were a few failures where that seemed like an obvious explanation.  There are failures not covered by that theory, though.

QuirkyDM:

What about non-song effects, like Vernal Sonata?

Vernal Sonata is acceptable.

QuirkyDM:

Do you have to win the game?

Not well-tested, but there was one failure that ended in a defeat by hero incapacitation that seems like it probably would have been a success otherwise.  Sudden death losses have not been tested.

Well, I have my second unlock, but I'm not sure if it tells us anything.

Since my wife doesn't have any season 2 content, I did Legacy / Ra / Chrono-Ranger / Omnitron-X / Argent Adept in Insula Primalis vs. Advanced Plague Rat. Once again, it was a damage-fest. Once again, it ended in two rounds. This time, AA did a total of 20 damage:

10 to Plague Rat in round 1 from Scherzo (same modifiers)

Then, PR was down to 5 HP on AA's second turn. Infection whiffed because of Heroic Interception, and PR went down from the first hit from Scherzo. (Same modifiers as before).

AA did exactly 20 damage in 2 turns (15 to Plague Rat and 5 to himself, all Fire because of Imbued Fire), and I got the unlock.
